title: The Libreswan IKEv2 state machine did not verify that an IKE_INTERMEDIATE exchange was required to satisfy the addke=…
description: A vulnerability in Libreswan's IKEv2 state machine allows a connecting client to skip the required IKE_INTERMEDIATE exchange when using the addke= PostQuantum algorithm component. This causes the connection to fall back to classical key exchange algorithms only, weakening cryptographic protection against future quantum attacks. The issue affects connections configured with the addke= option in ike= and/or esp= settings. PostQuantum Hybrid Key Exchange support was introduced in Libreswan version 5.4.
